title: Baby Tracker Diaper Daily Count Leaderboard
dataSources: Baby feeds (`baby:feed`), baby sleep (`baby:sleep`), diaper changes (`diaper:change`), chore completions (`chore:completion`), allowance ledger (`allowance:ledger`), family calendar (`family:calendar`), growth measurements (`growth:measurement`), screen time (`screentime:usage`).
app: Baby-tracking app exports (Huckleberry/Baby Daybook), chore and allowance boards, shared family calendars, screen-time reports, and growth logs via Splunk HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=babytracker:diaper count=*
| stats sum(count) as total_value, avg(count) as avg_value by diaper_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks diaper type values by total and average daily count across Baby Tracker diaper events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `count` values for each Baby Tracker diaper event and review total and average daily count by diaper type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total daily count.
grandmaExplanation: It scores which diaper type shows the biggest daily count numbers in your Baby Tracker diaper data.
